# ForgeMesh Labs
> ForgeMesh Labs publishes production-running MCP servers, x402-paid APIs, commercial intelligence services, affiliate routing, and machine-readable discovery surfaces for agent commerce.

## Primary Site
- Website: https://forgemesh.io
- X: https://x.com/forgemeshlabs
- Machine index: https://forgemesh.io/index.json
- OpenAPI discovery: https://forgemesh.io/openapi.json
- Sitemap: https://forgemesh.io/sitemap.xml

## Hosted x402 APIs
- x402 Proxy (self-serve paywall platform): https://proxy.forgemesh.io
  - Product page: https://forgemesh.io/proxy
  - OpenAPI: https://proxy.forgemesh.io/openapi.json
  - x402 metadata: https://proxy.forgemesh.io/.well-known/x402.json
  - llms.txt: https://proxy.forgemesh.io/llms.txt
  - What it does: anyone can paywall a URL they control. Verify domain ownership by DNS TXT record, paste a URL, set a price ($0.001-$100 per request), and AI agents pay in USDC on Base mainnet to call it. No code required.
  - Payouts are non-custodial: each payment settles directly to a per-creator immutable 0xSplits contract on Base, allocating 85% to the creator and 15% to ForgeMesh. The platform never takes possession of creator earnings and cannot redirect them. Distribution is permissionless — ForgeMesh triggers it monthly and pays the gas, but creators can trigger it themselves at any time.
  - Pricing: free to set up, no subscription. 15% commission per payment.
- CoinOpAI x402 API: https://x402.coinopai.com
- ImageGen x402 API: https://imagegen.coinopai.com
- Disruption Intelligence API: https://disruption.forgemesh.io
  - Discovery: https://disruption.forgemesh.io/index.json
  - OpenAPI: https://disruption.forgemesh.io/openapi.json
  - x402 metadata: https://disruption.forgemesh.io/.well-known/x402.json
  - Product: DisruptionIntel by ForgeMesh Labs
  - Flagship: Disruption Intelligence Ripple Report
  - Scope: source-linked WARN and workforce disruption intelligence with downstream business-ripple analysis
  - Paid endpoints: 23 endpoints from $0.01-$0.25 per call on Base mainnet
  - Categories: event severity, event history, relationships, timelines, company intelligence, company search, radius search, territory disruption, regional summaries, jurisdiction activity, watchlist previews, Ripple Signals, Ripple Paths, and Ripple Reports
- ForgeMesh Travel Agent API: https://travel-agent.forgemesh.io
  - MCP quickstart: npx -y @forgemeshlabs/travel-agent-mcp
  - x402 manifest: https://travel-agent.forgemesh.io/.well-known/x402.json
  - OpenAPI: https://travel-agent.forgemesh.io/openapi.json
  - MCP package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@forgemeshlabs/travel-agent-mcp
